name: Question 13
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096165/assets/0f95f6b259237816a5a3da041452cfd9458f0852b1ae717a044738b6f310ab5d.png)

Describe the shaded region shown above using set-builder notation.

$$
{(x,y)\in {{field-1}}\,:\,3\,{{field-2}}\,y\,{{field-3}}\,2x+3}
$$
worked_solution:
The points in our set include all those that lie *above* the line $y=3$ and *below* the line $y=2x+3.$

A point $P(x,y)$ lies *inside* the shaded region if the following conditions are satisfied:

$$
y>3,\,y<2x+3.
$$

Combining this into a single condition, we have

$$
3<y<2x+3.
$$

We must also include the lines $y=3$ and $y=2x+3$ since the boundaries are included in the set (the lines are solid). So, we change the corresponding inequality symbols above as follows:

$$
3\le y\le 2x+3
$$

Moreover, since we're considering *every* real value in this region, $x\in R,y\in R,$ and therefore 

$$
(x,y)\in R\times R={R}^{2}.
$$

Therefore, we can write the set as

$$
{(x,y)\in {R}^{2}\,:\,3\le y\le 2x+3}.
$$
